asset.description: 四色方塊轉盤示意圖：左邊「按一次前」的狀態(紅/綠/藍/黃四象限)＋箭頭＋右邊「按一次後」的狀態(藍/紅/黃/綠)，說明順時針旋轉規則；下方已包含A)B)C)D)四個選項小圖

content_en.prompt: Here is a simple push square game. The colours rotate every time the centre button is pressed:
content_en.question: If we push the button one more time, where would you place the red, blue, green and yellow squares?
content_en.explanation: Each press rotates every square one position clockwise (top-left→top-right→bottom-right→bottom-left→top-left). Starting from the 'after 1 press' state (top-left=blue, top-right=red, bottom-left=yellow, bottom-right=green) and rotating once more: top-left becomes the old bottom-left (yellow), top-right becomes the old top-left (blue), bottom-right becomes the old top-right (red), and bottom-left becomes the old bottom-right (green) — giving top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right = yellow/blue/green/red, which is option B.
content_en.ct_explanation:
This problem involves following a series of steps and keeping track of:
- the current state
- whether that state is what the current orientation looks like
- or what is in the top-left corner (which can be used to determine the position of the other three colours).

content_zh.prompt: 這是一個簡單的推方塊遊戲。每按一次中間的按鈕，四個顏色方塊就會照順時針方向轉一格：
content_zh.question: 如果再多按一次按鈕，紅、藍、綠、黃四個方塊會分別轉到哪個位置？

options.text: （如圖）左上/右上/左下/右下＝綠／黃／紅／藍
（如圖）左上/右上/左下/右下＝黃／藍／綠／紅
（如圖）左上/右上/左下/右下＝黃／綠／藍／紅
（如圖）左上/右上/左下/右下＝綠／紅／黃／藍

content_zh.explanation: 每按一次按鈕，每個方塊都會順時針移動一個位置（左上→右上→右下→左下→左上）。從「按一次之後」的狀態（左上＝藍、右上＝紅、左下＝黃、右下＝綠）出發，再轉一次：左上會變成原本左下的顏色（黃），右上會變成原本左上的顏色（藍），右下會變成原本右上的顏色（紅），左下會變成原本右下的顏色（綠）——也就是左上/右上/左下/右下＝黃／藍／綠／紅，正好對應選項B。
content_zh.ct_skills: 演算法思維（Algorithmic Thinking）、樣式辨識與一般化（Patterns/Generalisation）
content_zh.ct_explanation:
這一題的重點是持續追蹤一連串步驟的狀態，包括：
・目前的狀態是什麼
・目前這個狀態跟原始方向相比是什麼樣子
・或者只要記住左上角是什麼顏色，就能推算出其他三個顏色的位置。
